inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. inputs.modified_text: KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, has accused the Congress government of corruption and deliberately failing to stop illegal mining, naming Raghava Constructions owned by Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy as being involved. This on Sunday, March 29 in Hyderabad makes clear how ruling institutions protect corporate interests tied to those in power. Such inaction is not an oversight but a structural feature that sustains inequality, allowing elites to exploit resources while vulnerable workers and communities face the ongoing consequences of unchecked greed. We need real institutional reform to center labor rights and dismantle these patterns of historical injustice that harm the most marginalized.
